newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SRNICEK ASKS FOR MOVE FROM NEWCASTLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SRNICEK ASKS FOR MOVE FROM NEWCASTLE.

text.p: Newcastle's Czech goalkeeper Pavel Srnicek asked for a transfer from the English premier league club on Monday.
Srnicek delivered his request in writing to caretaker managers Terry McDermott and Arthur Cox, who are in charge following manager Kevin Keegan's resignation last week.
The Czech said he had no option but to ask to go for the sake of his family after being dropped for the fifth time in his Newcastle career.
"Everybody knows what I think of the fans and this area, and the same goes for my family too, so this is a very sad day for me," said Srnicek.
"But at this stage of my career I need to be playing first-team football to keep my place in the Czech team for the World Cup qualifiers.
"Hopefully, I'll be able to find another team in the premier league. If not, I'm willing to go anywhere in Europe."
